verdict.rationale: Turso documents a first-party MCP integration: any MCP-capable agent can connect and manage the Turso Cloud account (organizations, databases, groups) and run SQL on the user's behalf, with no API token to copy. A probe confirms the official MCP server documentation page exists. missing for 10: detailed setup/client configuration steps and full tool inventory in evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect any MCP-capable AI agent and it can manage your Turso Cloud account — organizations, databases, groups — and run SQL, on your behalf.
There’s no API token to copy or paste.
official MCP server documented at https://docs.turso.tech/integrations/mcp
